verdict.rationale: Crossplane docs describe Providers and Configurations as portable, installable packages and the CLI supports building, installing, updating and pushing Crossplane Packages, plus a 'library of components to assemble your platform faster' — all indicating a publish/consume workflow for reusable modules. However, there is no explicit evidence of a named public registry (e.g., Upbound Marketplace) or details on registry discovery/versioning workflows. Missing for 10: explicit public registry reference/marketplace evidence, developer-facing publish workflow walkthrough, independent confirmation of module reuse via registry.
